श्यान (II) n. Smoke.

श्याम (I) a. (f. मा) 1. Black, dark-coloured, अग्रे स्त्रीनखपाटलं कुरबकं श्यामं द्वयोर्भागयोः Vikr.ii., परिणत फलश्यामजंबूवनांताः Megh.i.23, 15, 57; 2. dark-green.
श्याम (II) m. 1. The black colour; 2. a cloud; 3. the Indian cuckoo; 4. name of a sacred fig tree at Allahabad, सोऽयं वटः श्याम
इति प्रतीतः
R.xiii.53.
श्याम (III) n. 1. Sea-salt; 2. black pepper.
श्याम (I) a. (f. मा) 1. Black, dark-coloured, अग्रे स्त्रीनखपाटलं कुरबकं श्यामं द्वयोर्भागयोः Vikr.ii., परिणत फलश्यामजंबूवनांताः Megh.i.23, 15, 57; 2. dark-green.

श्यामा f. 1. Night, (especially a dark night), श्यामां श्यामलिमानमानयत भोः K.Pr.vii.; 2. shade, shadow; 3. a dark woman a kind of woman, (described as यौवनमध्यस्था, or शीते सुखोष्णसर्वांगी ग्रीष्मे तु सुखशीतला । तप्तकांचनवर्णाभा सा स्त्री श्यामेति कथ्यये; 4. the first explanation is given by Mall. in his comment on Megh.ii.19, and Sis.viii.36; the second is given by Jayamangala in his gloss on Bt.v.18, where the words हंसनंदिनी and न्यग्रोधपरिमंडला are also technically used.); 5. a cow; 6. the female of the Indian cuckoo; 7. turmeric; 8. the sacred basil; 9. the river Yamunā; 10. the seed of the lotus; 11. the priyangu creeper, Megh.ii.41; 12. the Indigo plant.
श्याम-अंग m. the planet Mercury.
श्याम-कंठ m. 1. an epithet of Śiva; 2. a peacock.
श्याम-कर्ण m. a horse suitable for a horse-sacrifice.
श्याम-पत्र m. the Tamāla tree.
श्याम-सुंदर m. an epithet of Kṛṣṇa.
श्यामल (I) a. (f. ला) Black, blackish, इंदीवरश्रेणीश्यामलकोमलैरुपनयन्नंगैरनंगोत्सवम् Git.G.i.
श्यामल (II) m. 1. Black colour; 2. a large bee; 3. the sacred fig tree; 4. black pepper.
श्यामल (I) a. (f. ला) Black, blackish, इंदीवरश्रेणीश्यामलकोमलैरुपनयन्नंगैरनंगोत्सवम् Git.G.i.
श्यामलिका f. The Indigo plant.
श्यामलिमन् m. Blackness, darknes.
श्यामाक m. A kind of grass, श्यामाकमुष्टिपरिवर्धितको जहाति Sak.iv. (Also श्यामक.)
श्यामिका f. 1. Blackness, darkness; 2. impurity, alloy, हेम्नः संलक्ष्यते ह्यग्नौ विशुद्धिः श्यामिकापि वा R.i.10.
स्यमि(मी)क m. 1. A cloud; 2. an ant-hill; 3. a kind of tree; 4. time.
स्यमि(मी)क m. 1. A cloud; 2. an ant-hill; 3. a kind of tree; 4. time.
स्यमिका f. Indigo.
श्यामित a. (f. ता) Darkened, blackened.
श्यामित a. (f. ता) Darkened, blackened.
श्याल m. A wife’s brother, a brother-in-law.
स्याल m. The same as श्याल q.v.
श्यालक m. 1. A wife’s brother; 2. a miserable brother-in-law.
श्यालकी f. A wife’s sister.
श्यालकी f. A wife’s sister.
श्यालकी f. A wife’s sister.
श्याव (I) a. (f. वा or वी) Dark-brown, dark.
श्याव (II) m. The brown colour.
श्याव (I) a. (f. वा or वी) Dark-brown, dark.
श्याव (I) a. (f. वा or वी) Dark-brown, dark.
श्याव-तैल m. the mango tree.
स्यद m. Speed, rush, motion, velocity, भर्तृकृतेनागादिस्यदेन भुवि वस्तपरिहृतेनागागि Nal.iv.6.

स्यंद् vi. 1Ā (pp. स्यन्न; pres. स्यंदते; desid. सिस्यन्त्सति-ते, सिस्यंदिषते) 1. To trickle, to ooze, to drop, to flow out, व्यालुंपंति स्फुटजललवस्यंदिनश्चंद्रकांताः Megh.ii.7, Bt.xvi.7; 2. to run, to flee.With अभि-, to rain out, संततमभिष्यंदमानमेघमेदुरितनीलिमा गिरिः प्रस्रवणो नाम Ut.i.; 2. to ooze, to be melted.With नि-, to flow.
स्यंद m. 1. Trickling; 2. going, moving rapidly; 3. a car, a chariot.
स्यंदन (I) a. (f. ना or नी) 1. Quick, swift, स्यंदना नो च तुरगाः सुरेर्भावा विपत्तयः Kir.xv.16; 2. flowing, going quickly.
स्यंदन (II) m. 1. A war chariot, a chariot, a car, मुहुरनुपतति स्यम्दने दत्तदृष्टिः Sak.i.; 2. air, wind; 3. a kind of tree.
स्यंदन (III) n. 1. The act of trickling, oozing; 2. rushing, going or flowing swiftly; 3. water.
स्यंदन (I) a. (f. ना or नी) 1. Quick, swift, स्यंदना नो च तुरगाः सुरेर्भावा विपत्तयः Kir.xv.16; 2. flowing, going quickly.
स्यंदन (I) a. (f. ना or नी) 1. Quick, swift, स्यंदना नो च तुरगाः सुरेर्भावा विपत्तयः Kir.xv.16; 2. flowing, going quickly.
स्यंदन-आरोह m. a warrior who fights mounted on a war-chariot.
स्यंदनिका f. A drop of saliva.
स्यंदिन् a. (f. नी) 1. Oozing, trickling; 2. going.
स्यंदिन् a. (f. नी) 1. Oozing, trickling; 2. going.
स्यंदिनी f. 1. Saliva; 2. a cow bearing twins.
स्यम् vt. 1P, 10U (pres. स्यमति, स्यमयति-ते) 1. To sound, to cry aloud, to shout; 2. to go; 3. to consider, to think.
स्यमंतक m. The gem worn by Kṛṣṇa; (given to Satrājit by the sun, and transferred by him to his brother Prasena, from whom it was taken by Jāmbavat. After much fighting, it was appropriated by Kṛṣṇa).
स्यात् ind. (third person sing. of the potential of अस् (II)) It may be, perhaps, perchance.
स्यात्-वाद m. an assertion of probability (in phil.).
स्यात्-वादिक m. a sceptic.
